description: This file contains functions and types for resolving session ID matches, including normalization, comparison, collapsing aliases, and selecting the most relevant session match.

methods.name: normalizeLookupKey
methods.description: Normalizes a lookup key by trimming and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: compareNormalizedUpdatedAtDescending
methods.description: Compares two normalized session ID matches based on their updatedAt timestamp in descending order.

methods.name: normalizeSessionIdMatches
methods.description: Normalizes an array of session ID matches, producing normalized session match objects.

methods.name: collapseAliasMatches
methods.description: Groups and collapses alias session matches, selecting the most relevant match within each group.

methods.name: selectFreshestUniqueMatch
methods.description: Selects the most recent unique session match based on updatedAt timestamp.
